reviewer: Claude review of the CI renders after the claim-marker and title-gap fixes

ru-board-notes.notes: Clear executive storyline, strong decision slide, native chart, readable Cyrillic, and compact source traceability.

ru-sales-proposal.notes: Coherent proposal flow with a purposeful pictogram, editable process, clean comparison, and visible evidence.

ru-xlsx-analysis.notes: Decision-focused financial narrative with editable native charts, legible table, metrics, and explicit sources.

ru-docx-strategy.notes: Strong sectioning and strategy arc; comparison and process remain editable and readable at presentation distance.

ru-long-copy.notes: Long Russian titles and denser copy remain unclipped, structured, and readable after dynamic title spacing.

ru-source-traceability.notes: Assumptions and facts are traceable slide by slide, with a structured sources appendix and editable evidence views.

ru-targeted-slide-edit.notes: Edited forecast is visually coherent while unaffected slide XML remains byte-identical to the source deck.

ru-template-fidelity.notes: Intentionally plain because the fixture uses PowerPoint's neutral default template; master, layouts, geometry, and inherited placeholders are preserved.

ru-process-deck.notes: Five-step and four-step flows stay aligned, editable, and legible, with a clear move from gates to decisions.

ru-en-mixed-business.notes: Russian and English business notation, currency, ratios, dates, native chart, and table render consistently.

reviewNotes: The digest is a raster hash and belongs to the renderer that made it, so it is taken from the CI run that scores the gate, not from a local one. Reviewed the run-1 montages that run published for ru-long-copy and ru-board-notes, the two cases carrying a claim slide: the accent marker now sits on the centre line of the claim it marks instead of an inch above it, and every title has a clear break before its content, including the three-line one that used to sit on its own bullets. Slide content is unchanged, so the per-case dimensions from the 2026-08-11 review still hold.
